name: flydiy
description: flyDiy — vendor build only: `npm install && node tools/vendor_three.js` regenerates vendor/three.min.js (W0.5a). The KTX2 bakers (AS3) also run basisu v1.16.4 from basis_universal@1.16.4-1. The game and its gates have no other dependency. The SOUND asset tools (tools/audio/excerpt.js, prep) decode with audio-decode and encode with lamejs; tools only, nothing shipped carries them.
